look: Ashvein Goblin Scavenger, a F-rank GKOM variant from the Ashvein Goblinkin family: small wiry adult goblin holding a plain flint shiv, ragged cloth, left-hip scavenger pouch. Family anatomy: wiry olive-grey goblinoids with long pointed ears, black GKOM veins and ragged scavenged cloth. Build: compact and agile. GKOM rank cue: only a few small GKOM crystal growths (two or three finger-length points); most of its natural skin, hide or surface is exposed; the crystals are smoky-grey quartz. A marble-sized GKOM core orb, murky grey, dim faint pulse, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Dark: violet, black and magenta accents, tiny subtle shadow smoke, star specks and dark sigils
